name: emw-merge-sets
label: EMwrap Merge Sets
help: Merge multiple tilt-series, tomogram, or particle/coordinate sets of the same type into one output set.

params.name: input_sets
params.label: Input sets:
params.help: Two or more STAR files of the same type: tilt_series.star, tomograms.star, or optimisation_set.star (TomoParticles / TomoCoordinates).
